note: Chapter 4 from docs/chapter-04/CHAPTER_04_PRODUCTION.md. Human lines are overheard.

C4_00_lorry.speaker: narrator
C4_00_lorry.text: An estate lorry, loaded with empty latex drums, is heading up the hill road to Bukit Getah.

C4_00_lorry.speaker: elias
C4_00_lorry.text: I know the radio in this cab. Terrible taste in music. Hop in the back!

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The lorry grinds up the hill road into the night.

gt01_lorry_back.speaker: narrator
gt01_lorry_back.text: The lorry goes back down to Bandar Kencana at dawn and dusk.

C4_01_estate.speaker: narrator
C4_01_estate.text: Bukit Getah Estate, after midnight. Rows of rubber trees stretch up the hill. The tappers' lanterns flicker.

C4_01_estate.speaker: tapper
C4_01_estate.text: (to her friend) Third lantern gone out tonight. And no wind.

C4_01_estate.speaker: tapper_b
C4_01_estate.text: Leave it. Start on the lower rows. The top lanes feel... wrong.

C4_01_estate.speaker: reno
C4_01_estate.text: The trees are whispering. Can you hear them? They sound scared.

C4_01_estate.speaker: lumi
C4_01_estate.text: Something here is very frightened, and it's making everything else frightened too.

C4_01_estate.speaker: elias
C4_01_estate.text: And that ink smell again. Faint, but it's here.

C4_01_estate.speaker: narrator
C4_01_estate.text: New goal: find out what's frightening the grove (north).

human_tapper.speaker: tapper
human_tapper.text: (scoring a tree, catching the drip in a cup) Slow tonight. The trees bleed slow when it's cold. It isn't cold.

human_tapper_b.speaker: tapper_b
human_tapper_b.text: (to herself) My grandmother said the grove had a little keeper. You'd leave the first cup alone for her. Silly.

human_tapper_after.speaker: tapper
human_tapper_after.text: (at dawn, surprised) The cups are full. Every one. Like the trees woke up happy.

human_tapper_b_after.speaker: tapper_b
human_tapper_b_after.text: (quietly, leaving the first cup alone) For the little keeper. Just in case.

C4_02_grove.speaker: narrator
C4_02_grove.text: Deep in the grove, three trees have turned black and twisted across the lanes.

C4_02_grove.speaker: reno
C4_02_grove.text: This one's shaking. Trees don't shake.

C4_02_grove.speaker: elias
C4_02_grove.text: Maybe if someone spoke its language...

C4_02_grove.speaker: lumi
C4_02_grove.text: Reno. You were raised in a village made of roots. Try listening.

tree_look.speaker: narrator
tree_look.text: A rubber tree, black with fright, twisted across the lane.

tree_look.speaker: lumi
tree_look.text: Reno should try. He grew up talking to roots.

tree_calm.speaker: narrator
tree_calm.text: The tree stands up straight again, a little embarrassed.

whisper_1.speaker: narrator
whisper_1.text: Reno puts both hands on the bark and listens.

whisper_1.speaker: narrator
whisper_1.text: Reno learned Forest Whisper! (Reno leads, A at a frightened tree.) And Root Uppercut! (5 MP)

whisper_1.speaker: narrator
whisper_1.text: The tree shivers. Its bark still has old knife scores, healed over.

then.speaker: reno
then.text: Nobody's going to cut you tonight.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The tree sighs, all its leaves at once, and untwists out of the lane.

then.speaker: reno
then.text: The moon is up, see?

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The tree shivers harder.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: That's not what it's scared of. Look at it again.

then.speaker: reno
then.text: Your neighbours are right here.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The tree shivers harder.

then.speaker: lumi

whisper_2.speaker: narrator
whisper_2.text: The tree's leaves are curled tight against the dark. It can't see the sky.

trees_check.speaker: narrator
trees_check.text: All through the grove, the trees settle. But past the last row, something small is crying.

gt02_lurker_beaten.speaker: reno
gt02_lurker_beaten.text: Sticky! It's all over my scarf!

gt02_shades_beaten.speaker: elias
gt02_shades_beaten.text: Grove Shades. Little pieces of fear, floating loose.

gt02_mixed_beaten.speaker: lumi
gt02_mixed_beaten.text: They're coming from the same place. Past the last row.

C4_03_clearing.speaker: narrator
C4_03_clearing.text: A clearing by the old smokehouse, on the spirit side. A tiny pale spirit, like a drop of morning sap, is curled up by the wall.

C4_03_clearing.speaker: lumi
C4_03_clearing.text: Everyone stay back. Let me go first. Slowly.

mediation_1.speaker: titis
mediation_1.text: Who are you? Did HE send you? The one with ink on his fingers?

choice.text: "Nobody sent us. We came because the trees were scared."

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Nobody sent us. We came because the trees were scared.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: We're here to stop you!

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Titis curls up again. (Talk to her again, gently.)

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Tell us where he went, now.

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Titis curls up again. (Talk to her again, gently.)

mediation_2.speaker: titis
mediation_2.text: He took my name. I don't know who I am now. If I don't know, how can I keep the grove?

choice.text: "You don't need a name to be brave."

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: You don't need a name to be brave.

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Titis curls up again. (Talk to her again, gently.)

choice.text: "The tappers still leave you the first cup. They remember you."

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: The tappers still leave you the first cup. They remember you.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Just get a new name.

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Titis curls up again. (Talk to her again, gently.)

mediation_3.speaker: titis
mediation_3.text: I'm so scared. It's so big. It's all the scared I ever was, and it won't go away.

choice.text: "Then let it go. We'll stand between you and it."

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Then let it go. We'll stand between you and it.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Stop being scared.

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: Run away with us.

then.speaker: titis
then.text: (hiding her face) ...No. Go away.

then.speaker: narrator

C4_04_mediation.speaker: narrator
C4_04_mediation.text: Titis, keeper of the grove, peers out from behind her own hands.

mediation_done.speaker: titis
mediation_done.text: ...You'd stand there? Between me and that?

mediation_done.speaker: reno
mediation_done.text: All three of us. Elias is very tall.

mediation_done.speaker: narrator
mediation_done.text: Titis opens her hands. Something huge and dark pours out of her, and keeps pouring, and stands up behind the party.

mediation_done.speaker: titis
mediation_done.text: That's it. That's all of it. Please don't let it back in.

titis_after.speaker: titis
titis_after.text: The grove is quiet. The tappers will fill their cups. Thank you.

C4_05_shadow_intro.speaker: fear_shadow
C4_05_shadow_intro.text: EVERYONE LEAVES. EVERYONE CUTS. EVERYONE FORGETS.

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: narrator
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: The Fear-Shadow shrinks, and shrinks, until it is the size of a drop of sap, and then it is just morning mist.

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: titis
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: It's gone. I feel... small. Small is fine. Small is me.

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: titis
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: The man with ink on his fingers. He wasn't angry. He was sad, like me. He asked the way to Hutan Seribu Bunga.

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: lumi
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: The forest of a thousand flowers?

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: titis
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: He wanted a flower that helps people forget. He said, "so nobody has to remember".

C4_05_shadow_outro.speaker: elias
C4_05_shadow_outro.text: That's... not a villain's line. That's a sad person's line.

C4_06_dawn.speaker: narrator
C4_06_dawn.text: Dawn on Bukit Getah. The lanterns are lit, and the cups are full.

C4_06_dawn.speaker: tapper
C4_06_dawn.text: (laughing) Full cups. Every tree! What happened up here last night?

C4_06_dawn.speaker: tapper_b
C4_06_dawn.text: Leave the first cup. Just in case.

C4_06_dawn.speaker: reno
C4_06_dawn.text: A forest of a thousand flowers! Do they have trains?

C4_06_dawn.speaker: elias
C4_06_dawn.text: They have bees. I've heard them on shortwave. Very organised.
